translations.en: You will be redirected to the sign-in page.

translations.key: You've rated all your completed service requests. Thank you!

translations.en: You've rated all your completed service requests. Thank you!
translations.am: ሁሉንም የተጠናቀቁ የአገልግሎት ጥያቄዎችዎን ደረጃ ሰጥተዋል። እናመሰግናለን!
translations.om: Gaaffii tajaajilaa kee xumuraman hundaaf sadarkaa kenniteetta. Galatoomi!

translations.key: You've read everything. Switch to All to see your history.

translations.en: You've read everything. Switch to All to see your history.
translations.am: ሁሉንም አንብበዋል። ታሪክዎን ለማየት ወደ ሁሉም ይቀይሩ።
translations.om: Hunda dubbisteetta. Seenaa kee ilaaluuf gara Hundatti jijjiiri.

translations.key: Your account could be more secure

translations.en: Your account could be more secure
translations.am: መለያዎ የበለጠ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ሊሆን ይችላል

translations.key: Your account is not assigned to an office yet.

translations.en: Your account is not assigned to an office yet.
translations.am: መለያዎ እስካሁን ወደ ጽሕፈት ቤት አልተመደበም።
translations.om: Herregni kee hanga ammaatti waajjiratti hin ramadamne.

translations.key: Your account is not linked to an office. Please contact an administrator.

translations.en: Your account is not linked to an office. Please contact an administrator.
translations.am: መለያዎ ከጽሕፈት ቤት ጋር አልተያያዘም። እባክዎ አስተዳዳሪን ያግኙ።
translations.om: Herregni kee waajjira waliin hin walqabsiifamne. Maaloo bulchaa quunnami.

translations.key: Your account is now more secure.

translations.en: Your account is now more secure.
translations.am: መለያዎ አሁን የበለጠ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ነው።

translations.key: Your account is protected with an authenticator app

translations.en: Your account is protected with an authenticator app

translations.key: Your assigned service requests and upcoming work

translations.en: Your assigned service requests and upcoming work
translations.om: Gaaffiiwwan tajaajilaa siif ramadamanii fi hojii dhufaa jiru

translations.key: Your gateway to digital government services. Track requests, book appointments, and manage documents — all in one place.

translations.en: Your gateway to digital government services. Track requests, book appointments, and manage documents — all in one place.
translations.am: ወደ ዲጂታል የመንግሥት አገልግሎቶች መግቢያዎ። ጥያቄዎችን ይከታተሉ፣ ቀጠሮ ይያዙ፣ ሰነዶችን ያስተዳድሩ — ሁሉም በአንድ ቦታ።
translations.om: Balbala kee gara tajaajila mootummaa dijitaalaatti. Gaaffii hordofi, beellama qabadhu, sanadoota bulchi — hunduu bakka tokkotti.

translations.key: Your manager account is not assigned to an office yet.

translations.en: Your manager account is not assigned to an office yet.
translations.am: የሥራ አስኪያጅ መለያዎ እስካሁን ወደ ጽሕፈት ቤት አልተመደበም።
translations.om: Herregni bulchaa keetii hanga ammaatti waajjiratti hin ramadamne.

translations.key: Your manager record was not found. Please re-login.

translations.en: Your manager record was not found. Please re-login.
translations.am: የሥራ አስኪያጅ መዝገብዎ አልተገኘም። እባክዎ እንደገና ይግቡ።
translations.om: Galmeen bulchaa keetii hin argamne. Maaloo irra deebi'ii seeni.
Ilaalcha waliigalaa fi xiinxala waajjira keetii

translations.key: Your password has been updated successfully. You can now sign in with your new password.

translations.en: Your password has been updated successfully. You can now sign in with your new password.
translations.am: የይለፍ ቃልዎ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ተዘምኗል። አሁን በአዲሱ የይለፍ ቃልዎ መግባት ይችላሉ።
translations.om: Jechi iccitii kee milkaa'inaan haaromfameera. Amma jecha iccitii kee haaraatiin seenuu dandeessa.

translations.key: Your selection is saved on this device and used for My Office analytics.

translations.en: Your selection is saved on this device and used for My Office analytics.
translations.am: ምርጫዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ተቀምጦ ለጽሕፈት ቤቴ ትንታኔ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል።
translations.om: Filannoon kee meeshaa kana irratti olkaa'amee xiinxala Waajjira Kootiif oola.

translations.key: Your staff record was not found. Please re-login.

translations.en: Your staff record was not found. Please re-login.
translations.am: የሠራተኛ መዝገብዎ አልተገኘም። እባክዎ እንደገና ይግቡ።
translations.om: Galmeen hojjetaa keetii hin argamne. Maaloo irra deebi'ii seeni.

translations.key: Your submitted ratings will appear here once you rate a completed request.

translations.en: Your submitted ratings will appear here once you rate a completed request.
translations.am: ያስገቡት ደረጃዎች የተጠናቀቀ ጥያቄ ደረጃ ከሰጡ በኋላ እዚህ ይታያሉ።
translations.om: Sadarkaan galchite erga gaaffii xumurameef sadarkaa kennitee booda asitti mul'ata.
